text:
maria-sales: Hey team — VARA wants to start a 4-week POC next Tue. Requirements they listed: SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning with role mapping, per-tenant RBAC, domain-locking for email verification, and KMS-backed key management.
They also asked if Hosted is acceptable for their data rules or if Dedicated/Private is required. Need an indicative POC pricing for ~2k reqs/day (mainly chat/embeddings) and token cost expectations. Any known blockers on security questionnaire items we should flag? cc @alex.s @thomas.eng @jessica-sec

alex.s: Thanks — quick checklist from SE side: confirm (1) SCIM attribute map (which external IDs/roles do they need), (2) SAML metadata (IdP entityID + cert + want encrypted assertions?), (3) RBAC surface: org-level vs team-level scopes, and (4) whether they need audit log forwarding (SIEM).
Can we ask VARA whether they expect push provisioning (SCIM create/update) or only pull sync? If push, we should provide a token + webhook URL.
Example SCIM request we give them for reference:
```
curl -X POST "https://redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userName":"alice@vara.com","externalId":"vara-123","schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Lee"}}'
```
Also include sample role mapping like `scim:roles -> redwood:roles` and whether they need nested groups.

thomas.eng: A couple engineering notes:
- SCIM rate limits: for Hosted we'd recommend <=100 reqs/min per customer during POC; Dedicated can be configured higher.
- Our SCIM endpoint path is `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups` and we support PATCH with RFC7644.
- For SAML, we accept metadata XML or manual fields (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert). If they want encrypted assertions, we'll need their encryption cert.
- For Private deployments we can integrate with their KMS/HSM (KMIP or cloud KMS) for HSM-backed key material; Hosted supports envelope encryption with our KMS but not BYO KMS.

jessica-sec: Security checklist items to surface back to VARA: 
- We can provide SOC2 Type II report and ISMS overview.
- FedRAMP/IL5: not supported on Hosted; may be possible for Private but requires an engagement.
- Data residency: Hosted runs in our regions (US/EU/APAC); Dedicated offer region pinning and network isolation.
- Does VARA require customer-managed keys? If yes, mark Private as likely required.
- Ask if they need SCIM audit trails sent to their SIEM (we can forward via syslog/HTTPS).

maria-sales: They replied quickly: SCIM push preferred, need groups->roles mapping, require encrypted SAML assertions, and they want audit logs forwarded to Splunk. They're early in procurement and asked for cost ranges (POC + if we had to move to Dedicated afterwards).

alex.s: Ballpark pricing guidance for planning only:
- Hosted POC: we usually offer credits + usage billing. For ~2k reqs/day with mixed chat/embedding expect token costs in the low hundreds per month — estimate $200–$500/mo depending on prompt length and reprompting.
- Dedicated (reserved) for predictable throughput + isolation: initial commit typically starts in low thousands/month (depends on GPU type and concurrency) — for a small 1-2 GPU reserved pool estimate $3k–6k/mo as a rough entry point.
- Private (on-prem/VPC) has platform licensing + infra; requires solutions engineering scoping.
These are estimates — I'll follow up with finance for a formal POC quote.

jessica-sec: For the Splunk forwarding we need their ingestion endpoint and token type. We'll propose sending audit events (auth, SAML assertions used, SCIM changes) to a dedicated secure endpoint. Need to confirm retention/PII rules.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: "Dedicated capacity reservation slot" tentative hold for VARA POC on 2025-02-12 09:00 UTC — react :white_check_mark: to confirm.

maria-sales: Next steps I have: (1) confirm whether VARA can accept our Hosted audit events format or wants raw logs, (2) get SCIM attribute mapping (they said groups map to roles), (3) collect SAML metadata (IdP entityID + cert + encryption cert). I'll book Wed 10am kick-off with VARA and invite SE + Sec.

alex.s: I'll prepare a short config walkthrough + a SCIM mapping template and a preliminary POC quote for finance.

jessica-sec: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers and list the items that force Private deployment.

maria-sales: great — thanks everyone. Will post VARA's SCIM mapping in this thread when I have it. :thumbsup:
